title: Concept: Elasticsearch cluster info disclosed in a response
description: The Elasticsearch root response states the product tagline, the cluster and node names, the version and the build hash. That answer is only produced by a cluster that accepts unauthenticated requests, so the disclosure and the missing access control arrive together.
applicability: Responses served by Elasticsearch on a reachable HTTP port.
risk: An unauthenticated search cluster discloses its identity and usually its data; HIGH severity because the same port serves index and document APIs.
